name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Avant le § 1 - Am 24
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: -1. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to recognise the right to housing as a fundamental, inalienable and non-negotiable right that must be guaranteed to all individuals regardless of their status; stresses that in order to make this right legally enforceable, regulatory and financial provisions should be put in place, along with urgent and coordinated measures to prevent evictions and foreclosures that violate this right and to ensure adequate social protection measures;
